sentences.text: Both studies looked at other markets and other years than today's American stock market, so they give the odds there, not a law for every market.
What these counts can't do is check any one trader's month: a screenshot of a small account turned into a big one is neither confirmed nor ruled out by a tally of everyone who tried.
If someone sells you a strategy as consistent, ask for audited results across every account and every month, not the best screenshot.
And if you try it anyway, put in only what you can afford to lose, and judge yourself by your results after fees, not by your best day.
